notablePrerequisites:
Must be able to produce 6UUG on each of your turns.
Must be able to play a land this turn.
description:
Cast Time Warp targeting yourself.
Cast Bala Ged Recovery targeting Time Warp.
Play Bala Ged Santuary from your graveyard.
Return Bala Ged Sanctuary to your hand with Trade Routes.
Pass the turn to yourself.
Repeat.

uses.name: Bala Ged Recovery // Bala Ged Sanctuary
